milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate near the oak trapdoors at the entrance of the stone brick smelting room and face them. The trapdoors are at spawn-relative (6,0,3) and (7,0,3). Target is set to [6,0,3]. max_distance reduced from 16 to 5 per Validator feedback to ensure the player has actually walked toward the trapdoors (they are ~7 blocks from spawn, so max_distance=5 requires meaningful navigation). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at the trapdoors, not just passing by.

Uses position_near_with_facing because interacting with a blast furnace requires the player to be within right-click range and facing it. The blast furnace is at spawn-relative (7,0,6). max_distance=3 ensures the player is within Minecraft's interaction range (~4.5 blocks), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are oriented toward the furnace. This is a proximity-based approximation of interaction since blast furnace GUI opening may not reliably appear in the use_item counter. Being within 3 blocks and facing it is a strong indicator the player has approached and is ready to/has interacted with it.
